name: collection_absorb_full_shelf
description: Loot folding at a full 12-row collection (docs/loot.md §34.5, AGENTS.md §52.19): the starter BRONZE_SWORD row (2 of cap 3) plus nine distinct plain filler ids fill every shelf slot (the wood-dagger filler is id 99: a plain bronze sword filler would already fold into the curated row and spoil the 2->3 setup); a bronze fire-sword id (derived id 0x90, stripped to plain since swords never ride) matching the owned curated identity must fold into that row (2 -> 3) instead of vanishing as a false 'collection full' failure. Pre-fix deck_collection_add rejected the grant before the merge could fold it.
